method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the concept of ecstatic dance as free movement without judgment, encourages warming up the body with spontaneous motion, and guides the learner through progressively energetic and then calming movement cycles.

practices.what: Move the body lightly to warm up, focusing on feet and shoulders without rigid choreography.
Increase the movement speed slightly to express life and let the spirit feel ecstatic.
Keep the energy flowing continuously through various body parts with joyful expression.
Slow down the pace gradually while maintaining connection to the body and inner vibrations.

beliefs.belief: Traditional structured dance puts spirits and minds in a box, whereas free movement frees the inner self.

clicked.theme: Realizing ecstatic dance is just dancing freely at home
The guidance and encouraging words made it easy

meant.theme: Released body tension and brought immense joy and gratitude
